_doc: Which tool arguments name a tenant target, for hooks/tenancy_guard.py. When a session is bound to an opp (bin/ace-bind), every matching MCP write is checked against that opp's tenancy (ace-web GET /api/w/{ws}/opps/{slug}/tenancy) and refused if it points anywhere else. 'tool_pattern' is a regex on the tool NAME (suffix-matched, because hosts register plugins as mcp__plugin_ace_ace-connect__X or mcp__ace-connect__X). Each 'args' entry maps an argument path (dot = nested key, [] = every list element) to the tenancy field(s) it must equal; a list of fields means any of them. An ABSENT argument is not checked (the tool's own default applies — see 'server_env' for tools whose tenant is fixed at server start). Read-only tools are deliberately absent: reading a shared source (e.g. copying FROM the shared HQ space into a partner space) is allowed, so upstream/source arguments are not listed. Spec: ace-web docs/specs/2026-09-28-clone-and-release-design.md § D.
